answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system anchored to a proof-of-stake mechanism as a Sybil resistance mechanism. Each agent stakes a "pearl" of computational resources, visible as a copper-weighted vote, to participate in consensus. Agents with malicious intent must expend velvet-smooth, high-frequency transactions to manipulate stakes, only to be thwarted by slashing protocols that confiscate ill-gotten stakes, costing the attacker a substantial portion of their invested resources.
